name: 小猪和小猫（毛绒）
summary: 一对毛绒搭档：粉色羊毛毡小猪（定稿，见 concept-pig.png 右边那只）＋ 一只毛绒小猫（待用户在 cat-1/2/3 里选）。针毡羊毛质感、豆豆眼、粉腮红、暖色木质房间、柔光浅景深，不加白描边。
look: Needle-felted wool plush toy characters, very soft fuzzy fibers, round chubby bodies, small black bead eyes, rosy pink cheeks, kawaii and gentle. A pink felted piglet with floppy ears and a curly tail. Warm cozy wooden room background, soft warm light, shallow depth of field, square 1:1. No text.
